description: Every field a call to screenshots may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

appearances.description: light, dark, or both; both when left out

arguments.description: launch arguments every launch adds after `-mock YES -destination <case>`, such as `["-signedIn", "YES"]`

destinations.description: the pages to open, as the app's AppDestination cases (`feed`, `settings`); every case when left out

devices.description: where to capture: simulator names like `iPhone 18 Pro`, or `iPhone` and `iPad` for the newest installed, and `Mac` for the Mac app (its window shows on this Mac while it is captured); the newest iPhone and iPad when left out

into.description: the folder for the images, relative to the project; Resources/Screenshots when left out

scheme.description: the scheme that builds the iOS app; the project's `<App>-iOS` when left out

settle.description: the most seconds to wait for a screen to stop changing before it is kept; 15 when left out

title: What screenshots takes (craft-agent/1)
